response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with strengths in TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang, but lacks nearly all critical requirements for this role: no native-level Japanese proficiency (languages listed are English, Romanian, German), no Linux kernel investigation or modification experience, no embedded networking or LAN-switch background, and no exposure to the required security technologies (MACsec, 802.1X, tamper detection). His C experience is limited to a brief stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015, far below the strong C-for-UNIX proficiency required.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured software engineering career with systems-level exposure (DLang low-latency services, Linux)
Some C/C++ experience at National Instruments and comfort working close to the OS
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD) and demonstrated ability to learn new stacks
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency — a hard requirement for the role
No embedded firmware, networking security, or LAN-switch product experience
No Linux kernel analysis/modification experience and only dated, limited C proficiency

key_factors.factor: General seniority and systems programming exposure
